name: Living By Example
overview: Scripture calls believers to live in a manner that visibly reflects the transformative power of Christ, exemplified by letting their light shine through good works to glorify God (Matthew 5:16). This lifestyle includes walking honestly and decently, avoiding sinful behaviors such as drunkenness and strife (Romans 13:13), and speaking with accountability before God (Matthew 12:36). Believers are urged to imitate God as His beloved children and to walk as children of light, embracing the new identity found in Christ who lives within them by faith (Ephesians 5:1, 5:8; Galatians 2:20).
